command:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin
git checkout integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
git reset --hard origin/integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
[ -z "$(git status --short)" ]
[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "48d20ed7e17107a3d1378a394b12b5382ae58a49" ]
. ~/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh >/dev/null
idf.py reconfigure >/dev/null
ROOT=managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee
FILES=$(find "$ROOT" -type f -print | grep -Ei '/([^/]*(on_off|level|command)[^/]*)$' | sort || true)
printf '%s\n' '=== matching files ==='
printf '%s\n' "$FILES"
printf '%s\n' '=== declarations ==='
for f in $FILES; do
  printf '\n--- %s ---\n' "$f"
  grep -nE -C 3 'typedef.*cmd|cmd_req|command request|ON|OFF|TOGGLE|MOVE_TO_LEVEL|LEVEL_CONTROL' "$f" | sed -n '1,260p' || true
done
